  1. ### What are the benefits of giving your dog DENTASTIX™ dental treats? 

PEDIGREE® DENTASTIX™ dental treats provide triple action dental care to help keep your dog’s teeth clean, freshen their breath, and reduce plaque and tartar buildup. Their unique X shape and chewy texture help scrape away plaque while chewing to help clean hard-to-reach teeth.

  2. ### Can puppies have DENTASTIX™?

PEDIGREE® DENTASTIX™ dental treats can be given to puppies above the age of 6 months after they develop their adult teeth. Until they’re old enough to have them, feed your puppy dedicated puppy foods.

  3. ### How often should I give my dog PEDIGREE® DENTASTIX™ dental treats? 

It’s recommended to feed one PEDIGREE® DENTASTIX™ dental treat per day to help clean their teeth, freshen their breath, and reduce plaque and tartar buildup.
